messages:
maria: Heads-up: multiple customers reporting 502s and timeouts on hosted inference endpoints since 03:45 UTC. High error spikes, most traces show gateway -> cache timeouts. Escalating to infra. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Alert: cache-prefetch-proxy error rate > 20% in us-west-2 for prefix-kv (memcached) at 03:46 UTC
riley: Which endpoints? any common model or route?
maria: Mostly /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for medium seq loads. Customer ticket INC-8242 mentioned retries causing billing noise.
kevin: I pulled collector logs — seeing repeated `ERR conn reset` to memcached pool from prefetch-proxy. Example snippet:
```
2026-03-17T03:46:12Z prefetch-proxy[pid=42] ERROR upstream=memcached-12 region=us-west-2 err="connection reset by peer" key_prefix="user:acct123"
2026-03-17T03:46:12Z gateway[pid=101] WARN route=/v1/generate status=502 latency_ms=1203 upstream_err=timeout
```
jordan: Any recent deploys to prefetch-proxy or pool config changes?
maria: Not on prefetch-proxy. There was a memcached group scaling tweak at 02:30 UTC to add nodes (auto-scale).
riley: Could be flapping connections during rebalancing + pool keepalive settings. Can you run a quick connection health check to one of the memcached hosts? `echo stats | nc -w1 $HOST 11211`
kevin: Ran `stats` against memcached-12, gets intermittent responses. Also kernel logs from memcached host show `tcp_abort_on_overflow` events.
support-tier2: Customers impacted: 4 enterprise customers, two with SLAs. INCs: INC-8242, INC-8247. Flagging priority P1 for infra assist.
maria: Workaround idea: flip route to bypass prefetch layer and hit kv fallback (read-through origin) for 10m to drain pool. That will increase origin load but reduce gateway 502s. Any objections?
jordan: Agree. Also suggest temporarily increasing connection pool size on prefetch-proxy and enabling aggressive TCP keepalive (60s) in config. Push a canary first.
kevin: I can do a targeted route tweak for affected customers now. Will also add iptables conntrack tune on the memcached hosts to avoid overflow.
riley: For root cause capture: please save EPOCHed logs from 03:30-04:00 UTC + netstat -anp on memcached hosts + prefetch-proxy pool stats. Also export a few failing request traces so we can see retry patterns.
maria: Collected traces and uploaded to S3 -> s3://redwood-incident-uploads/3110012345/ . Saved logs: prefetch-proxy.log, memcached-12-kernel.log, gateway-traces.json
support-tier2: Noted. Also, notify billing ops: repeated retries may charge customers. We need to mark eligible for credits if retries were automated by our SDK.
jordan: If rollback of memcached scale is needed, coordinate window with infra. Rolling back too fast could cause more rebalances. Prefer draining and routing around prefetch first.
kevin: Implemented route bypass for affected accounts at 03:58 UTC. Error rate dropped to ~1.3% within 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
maria: Customer update: told them we're routing around prefetch, monitoring, and will follow up with RCA.
riley: Next steps: infra to analyze memcached rebalance logs & kernel conntrack metrics. Also add alerts on `conn reset` spikes and pool saturation > 80%.
support-tier2: Filing internal followup ticket INFRA-1299 for memcached pool tuning + prefetch-proxy resilience (circuit-breaker, backoff). Assigning to kevin and riley.
jordan: Also add a postmortem doc and include repro steps and mitigations. I'll start a draft.
maria: Thanks team — continuing to monitor. Closing immediate P1 after stabilization but keeping on-call engaged until 06:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
